evidence.text: The user said: "I typically come to my office from about thirty miles out, so that distance is pretty consistent for my daily travel."
The user said: "I'm typically occupied with work between nine and five on weekdays."
The user said: "Honestly, I've always trusted my ability to bounce back from minor health issues without needing a lot of hand-holding."
The user said: "I've made a commitment to volunteer at the community center every Saturday."
The user said: "You know I generally sit out the big festivals; I've found over time that I much prefer spending my weekends at smaller gatherings or just at home."
The user said: "I generally save all my digital entertainment for the end of the day, so I'm usually looking at a screen for about an hour right before I turn off the lights."
The user said: "With my parents and grandparents living here too, I'm never really alone in the house."
The user said: "I still have the comprehensive policy on my personal belongings that I set up when I moved here."

policies.text: A plan or recommendation made for the user holds only while the personal circumstances it was based on still hold.
A reminder the user asked for stays scheduled until the user cancels it.
A preference the user stated applies to every later recommendation of the same kind.

updates.text: The user said: "I spent the afternoon on the phone with the estate agent, comparing listings for a one-bedroom—it's strange measuring rooms by how quiet they feel instead of how much space everyone needs."
The user said: "Lately I’ve been volunteering as an usher at the arena, and being in the middle of a packed crowd actually feels really fun to me now."

The user said: "Since the concussion, I’ve started keeping a little notebook in my jacket pocket—names, dates, even which cupboard the mugs are in—because if I don’t write things down the moment I hear them, they’re just… gone by dinner."
